prompt: Split a long list of values into batched INSERT statements with the right number of ? placeholders. Complete the batches method in BatchInserter, then run the tests.
explanation: Batching turns hundreds of round trips to the database into a handful, which is usually the single biggest win when inserting bulk data. The outer loop steps the start index forward by batchSize and Math.min keeps the last, possibly short, batch inside the list; the inner loop emits one (?) per value and a comma between them. Notice the values never appear in the SQL -- only placeholders do, so the same statement text can be reused with different bound values.
hints: Step the outer loop with start += batchSize instead of start++, so each pass handles a whole batch.
int end = Math.min(start + batchSize, values.size()) keeps the final short batch in range.
Inside a batch, append "(?)" for each value and a "," before every one except the first.
